narrative: Priscilla Huang contributed to TrueSight DAO and MarketMonocle from June 2021 to September 2022, with contributions primarily in the Build Game across strategy, operations, and user experience categories. She reviewed proposed strategies and suggested clear improvements (12 times) or cautions against certain actions (9 times), handled single line item operational tasks (8 times), and designed UI for single screen templates (8 times). Priscilla also contributed reference materials with strategy extension ideas (7 times), attended FaceTime meetings (7 hours), participated in online polls (5 times), and reviewed strategies with improvements (5 times).
